expenses_source_check.name: expenses_source_check
expenses_source_check.value: ("expenses"."source_kind" = 'custom' and "expenses"."source_id" is not null) or ("expenses"."source_kind" != 'custom' and "expenses"."source_id" is null)

expenses_end_month_check.name: expenses_end_month_check
expenses_end_month_check.value: ("expenses"."recurring" = false and "expenses"."end_month" is null) or ("expenses"."recurring" = true and ("expenses"."end_month" is null or "expenses"."end_month" > "expenses"."effective_month"))

goal_investment_positions_available_from.name: goal_investment_positions_available_from_check
goal_investment_positions_available_from.value: ("goal_investment_positions"."availability" = 'available_from' and "goal_investment_positions"."available_from" is not null) or ("goal_investment_positions"."availability" != 'available_from' and "goal_investment_positions"."available_from" is null)

incomes_source_check.name: incomes_source_check
incomes_source_check.value: ("incomes"."source_kind" = 'custom' and "incomes"."source_id" is not null) or ("incomes"."source_kind" != 'custom' and "incomes"."source_id" is null)

investment_contributions_usd_fields_chec.name: investment_contributions_usd_fields_check
investment_contributions_usd_fields_chec.value: ("investment_contributions"."currency" = 'USD' and "investment_contributions"."ars_spent" is not null and "investment_contributions"."effective_rate" is not null) or ("investment_contributions"."currency" = 'ARS' and "investment_contributions"."ars_spent" is null and "investment_contributions"."effective_rate" is null)

saving_contributions_usd_fields_check.name: saving_contributions_usd_fields_check
saving_contributions_usd_fields_check.value: ("saving_contributions"."currency" = 'USD' and "saving_contributions"."ars_spent" is not null and "saving_contributions"."effective_rate" is not null) or ("saving_contributions"."currency" = 'ARS' and "saving_contributions"."ars_spent" is null and "saving_contributions"."effective_rate" is null)
